skill.name: prd-builder
skill.description: PRD templates and structure for product requirements documents.
skill.body:
# PRD Builder Skill

Provides templates for creating comprehensive Product Requirements Documents. Keep asking questions to clarify doubts and get >= 95% understanding of what the user wants.

## When to Use

Automatically invoked by `/majestic:prd` command. Provides:

- Standard PRD template structure
- Technical expansion sections
- Backlog item format

## Templates

- [resources/prd-template.md](resources/prd-template.md) - Core PRD structure (10 sections)
- [resources/technical-expansion.md](resources/technical-expansion.md) - API, Data Model, Security, Performance sections

## Best Practices

- **Clear, actionable language** - Specific requirements, not vague descriptions
- **User story IDs** - Traceable requirements (US-001, FR-001)
- **Testable acceptance criteria** - Measurable success conditions
- **Explicit scope boundaries** - Non-goals prevent scope creep
- **Developer-ready** - Empowers "how" decisions while defining "what"

generated_query: I need to write a Product Requirements Document for a new feature in our task management app: a smart notification system that prioritizes alerts based on user activity and context. Can you help me structure the PRD? I want it to cover the core sections: user stories, functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and non-goals. Also include technical details like data model changes, API endpoints, and performance considerations. I’d like you to ask me clarifying questions to make sure you have at least 95% of the context before drafting. Start by asking about the primary use cases and any edge cases I should consider.

edit_instructions.target_text: Keep asking questions to clarify doubts and get >= 95% understanding of what the user wants.
edit_instructions.rationale: Without the requirement to ask clarifying questions, the skill will not engage with the user to gather sufficient context, failing the user's explicit need for pre-drafting clarification.
